image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of an ornate, vintage-style necklace lying on a white surface. The necklace features a thick, twisted rope-link chain in a rose-gold or copper tone. It includes two prominent circular medallion pendants encrusted with small, multi-colored faceted stones (appearing like rhinestones or crystals) and metallic filigree details. A portion of a second, similar jewelry item is visible in the blurred background at the top left.

artifact_observations.location: Connection point between upper chain and top-left background object
artifact_observations.reasoning: The chain links near the top left seem to merge ambiguously with the out-of-focus jewelry piece in the background. The depth separation is unclear, and the links appear to fuse rather than overlap cleanly.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and distinguish it from other jewelry types like bracelets or brooches.
To verify that the individual chain links are closed loops and properly interlocked without fusion, and that the stones are distinct entities within the settings.
To assess the realism of the metallic reflections and the sharpness of the gemstone facets, checking for AI-induced blurring or inconsistent lighting.

focus_areas: Integrity of chain link interlocking (no fused links)
Sharpness and geometric consistency of faceted stones
Separation between foreground necklace and background blur
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'rope' style chain links. AI often struggles with the continuous twist of rope chains, sometimes breaking the topology or merging links. Verify if the twists are consistent. Also, inspect the settings of the small stones; ensure they look physically set into the metal rather than painted on or floating.
